importantFindings.title: crew-management-gate.spec.ts fails at HEAD: the Mezzi-copy fix changed what the journey sees and the spec was not updated
importantFindings.evidence: node scripts/run-e2e.mjs --project pixel-7-chrome tests/e2e/crew-management-gate.spec.ts fails, and so does the same spec on iphone-13-webkit-core, at line 255 (assignDestination(page, 2, "Mezzi")): getByRole('button', { name: 'Mezzi' }) resolves to 2 elements, the chooser option and the crew header button 'Destinazione equipaggio 2: Mezzi'. Line 186 makes crew 2 Mezzi on Sabato PM, line 209 copies the crews to Domenica AM, and since 6db5aea (UG2-FUN-9, src/domain/crews.ts:193) the copy keeps Mezzi, so crew 2 is already Mezzi when the chooser opens and the substring match finds two buttons. The spec is not in the 5580d33..HEAD diff, so nobody ran it after the fix. With that one call removed in a scratch copy, the rest of the journey passes on pixel-7-chrome (15 s), so nothing else in it is stale.
importantFindings.impact: npm run verify:e2e, and so verify:all (a UG2 acceptance condition), is red on a previously passing journey; the gate cannot close until it is fixed. The product behaviour is the intended one; the spec encodes the old behaviour.
importantFindings.suggestedFix: Update the spec: after the copy, expect 'Destinazione equipaggio 2: Mezzi' to be visible instead of assigning it, or open the chooser for a crew that is not Mezzi and match the option exactly inside the chooser. Then re-run the whole browser suite once: the focused runs after 6db5aea missed this one, and it is the only one of about 120 specs I ran that fails.

importantFindings.title: Crew header overlaps its buttons at 412 px with 120% text and above, and the Barche list scrolls sideways at 390-412 px with 115-130% text and above; the UG2 reflow work was tuned to 320 px at 200% and misses this band
importantFindings.evidence: Pre-existing in 5580d33 (same classes, checked on a scratch copy of 5580d33 for the crew header) and not fixed by cf26355 or 1ec3e6c. Measured on HEAD with the 40-student hostile roster, text size set on <html>. Crew header (src/features/crews/CrewManagement.tsx:175-179: the title and the session label go side by side from a viewport of 400 px, `min-[400px]:flex-row`, with no wrap): header text lies under the board/summary buttons at 412 px from 120% to 175%, at 360 px from 150%, and at 390 px at 175%; 'Volontari' in the quick bar breaks as 'Volontar|i' at 412 px/150%; the page scrolls sideways at 412 px/175%. Barche list (src/features/boats/BoatManagement.tsx:366: the card wraps only under a viewport of 380 px, `max-[380px]:flex-wrap`): documentElement.scrollWidth minus clientWidth is 2 px at 390/115%, 41 px at 390/130%, 94 px at 390/150%, 19 px at 412/130%, 72 px at 412/150%, and the boat marks are cut at the right edge (screenshot barche-412-150). The other pages (Home, Allievi, Comandate, Equipaggi, Valutazioni, Volontari, Avarie, Impostazioni) have no sideways overflow from 100% to 150% at 360, 390 and 412 px; Avarie's state buttons overlap at 412 px/175%.
importantFindings.impact: 412 px is the Pixel 7 class of phone and 120-150% is an ordinary Android font-size setting. The crew page header, the page used most in the field, and the Barche list are visibly broken there, although the changelog says every page was checked down to 320 px at 200%, and the UG2 evidence covers 100% at 412, 390 and 360 px and 200% at 320 px only. No data is lost and the controls stay reachable.
importantFindings.suggestedFix: Move both from viewport media queries to the container/rem approach used elsewhere (`@max-[Nrem]` on the header or the card) so that they follow the text size, or let the crew header title row and the Barche card wrap (`flex-wrap`) at every width. Add 412 px at 130% and 150% to the layout audit profiles (tests/e2e/ug2-hostile-roster.spec.ts PROFILES) so the band cannot regress; or record it in the known limitations if it is accepted for 0.3.0.

qolFindings.title: A double tap on an in-app Back or close button leaves the whole area; the crew boats panel, which moved onto the history stack in UG2-UX-4 (1ec3e6c), now has the same weakness
qolFindings.evidence: Playwright dblclick (two clicks a few ms apart) on the dev server: Equipaggi, 'Apri barche della sessione', then double-click 'Torna agli equipaggi' lands on Home (history.state view home). Before 1ec3e6c the boats panel was a plain boolean (setBoatMode(false)), so a double tap was harmless there. The cause is src/navigation/browserHistory.ts:94 historyBack(), which calls window.history.back() every time, and src/navigation/nestedScreen.ts:66 closeScreen(), which calls it while the entry is still current; the second call arrives before the first popstate and goes one entry too far. Allievi, a student profile, then double-click 'Indietro da Profilo' does the same, so the pattern is older. Double 'Apri barche della sessione' and double 'Salva allievo' are safe (one entry, one student).
qolFindings.impact: A hurried double tap throws the instructor out of Equipaggi (or Allievi) to Home. Nothing is lost; the cost is a few taps to return.
qolFindings.suggestedFix: Make historyBack() ignore a second call while a Back it started is still pending (pendingBack already exists in the same file), or ignore taps on a Back control for the length of the transition.

qolFindings.title: With larger text the crew composition and the Comandate plan drop to one column earlier than before, which lengthens the two most used pages
qolFindings.evidence: cf26355 and 1ec3e6c: src/features/crews/CrewManagement.tsx:145-148 (PERSON_COLUMNS_*) and src/features/duties/DutyManagement.tsx:1590 (plan grid with a minimum of 8.5rem). Measured: crew slots in a 3-per-row setting are 3 columns at 412 px up to 130%, 2 columns from 150%, and 1 at 320 px/200%; the available-students pool is one column at 412 px/150% where 5580d33 shows two (screenshots cmp-crew-head-412-150 and cmp-crew-base-412-150). Comandate day cards: 2 columns up to 115% at 412 and 390 px, 1 column from 130%; at 360 px 1 column from 115%; at 320 px 1 column from 110%. The changelog still says Impostazioni chooses two or three names per row without saying that large text overrides it.
qolFindings.impact: An intended trade for names that are shown whole, but the composition page, whose cost per student the field-UX review already counted (UG2-UX-2), gets longer at 130-150% text, and the 3-per-row setting silently stops applying.
qolFindings.suggestedFix: Record the behaviour in the changelog's known limitations; consider keeping two columns for the pool down to 14rem (a first name is short there) and letting only the slots collapse.

qolFindings.title: The phone's Back from the crew destination chooser leaves Equipaggi for Home, while the same Back closes the summary overlay and the boats panel
qolFindings.evidence: Equipaggi, 'Destinazione equipaggio 1: ...' opens a fixed bottom section (src/features/crews/CrewManagement.tsx:2858-2862, no role dialog); page.goBack() then shows Home (history.state view home) and the chooser is gone. With the summary overlay open, goBack() closes only the overlay (verified on Equipaggi and on Comandate), and from the boats panel it returns to the composition. Same on 5580d33; the UG2-UX-4 comment calls the chooser a 'panel of the composition' without making Back close it.
qolFindings.impact: Back is inconsistent inside one page: the instructor loses the place on the composition page (the selected seat) for a panel that holds nothing unsaved.
qolFindings.suggestedFix: Close the chooser (and the warning detail) on Back the way a dialog is closed, for example by giving the chooser role=dialog and aria-modal so that closeActiveDialogOnBack applies.
